description: This file is a Node.js entry point script that ensures environment requirements, loads dependencies, manages module imports, and provides CLI help functionality for the 'openclaw' project.

methods.name: parseNodeVersion
methods.description: Parses a raw version string (e.g., '14.17.3') into an object with major and minor numbers.

methods.name: isSupportedNodeVersion
methods.description: Checks if a given Node.js version object meets the minimum required version.

methods.name: ensureSupportedNodeVersion
methods.description: Verifies that the current Node.js version is supported; exits with an error message if not.

methods.name: isModuleNotFoundError
methods.description: Determines if an error is a module not found error with code 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND'.

methods.name: isDirectModuleNotFoundError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a module not found error specifically for a given specifier.

methods.name: installProcessWarningFilter
methods.description: Asynchronously attempts to import and install a process warning filter from specified modules.

methods.name: tryImport
methods.description: Attempts to dynamically import a module, returning true on success, false if module is missing, and throwing other errors.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a file or directory exists at the specified URL.

methods.name: buildMissingEntryErrorMessage
methods.description: Constructs an error message indicating missing build artifacts, suggesting how to build or install the project.

methods.name: isBareRootHelpInvocation
methods.description: Determines if the CLI was invoked with help flags (-h or --help).

methods.name: loadPrecomputedRootHelpText
methods.description: Loads precomputed CLI help text from a JSON file, if available.

methods.name: tryOutputBareRootHelp
methods.description: Attempts to output CLI help information, sourced either from precomputed data or by importing help modules.
